name: web-dark-defi-site-with-sage-blur-glow-hero-and-glass-cards
title: Black DeFi site with a sage-grey blurred glow, thin white 'One-click for Asset Defense', orbit wallet diagram and bar-chart cards
whatItIs: A board of four dark screens: a hero with a huge blurred sage-grey light shape behind a thin white headline and small floating labels, a black 'Meet Marvellous Insights' page with rounded glass cards (98.2% orbit diagram, bar chart, growth stats), a 'DeFi Wallet' page with a circular dial and transaction chips, and a repeated hero.
whatItMeans: Moody and ethereal; blurred grey-green light gives a technical product a soft mystery.
techniques: Use big blurred light shapes as hero art.
Set thin white headlines on black.
Present data on dark glass cards with soft bars.

vocabulary.definition: Large blurred light shapes as a background.
A globe with an elliptical path and nodes.
A dark translucent card holding a chart.
